Besides Sichuan's government and the Ministry of Education, three major energy companies help sponsor it, and it forms part of the Double First-Class Construction plan.
southwest-university: Southwest University is a national public university in Beibei, Chongqing, tracing its beginnings to 1906. With about 60000 students, it is quite large. Funding is shared between the education ministry, the agriculture ministry and the Chongqing government, and the school has Project 211 status and is in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
southwest-university-of-political-scienc: SWUPL is a public university in Yubei, Chongqing, dating to 1950 and specialising in politics and law. Around 23,750 students study here. The city of Chongqing oversees it, with funding shared between the municipal government and the Ministry of Education, making it a focused choice for future legal professionals.
southwestern-university-of-finance-and-e: SWUFE is a public university in Chengdu, Sichuan, dedicated to finance and economics since 1925. The Ministry of Education oversees it, while the Sichuan provincial government co-funds it. You will also find it listed with Project 211 status and in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
sun-yat-sen-university: Sun Yat-sen University, known as SYSU, is a leading public research university in Guangzhou, Guangdong, opened in 1924. Some 34,096 students are enrolled. Funding comes jointly from the Ministry of Education, SASTIND and the Guangdong government, and it belongs to Project 211 and Project 985 as well as the Double First-Class Construction.
taiyuan-university-of-technology: Taiyuan University of Technology (TYUT) is a provincial public university of science and engineering in Taiyuan, Shanxi. Its history stretches back to 1902. The Shanxi provincial government funds it, and it has a place in the Double First-Class Construction programme as well as Project 211.
the-central-academy-of-drama: The Central Academy of Drama, founded in 1950, is a state-run public drama school in Beijing. It reports to the Ministry of Education and belongs to the Double First-Class Construction programme, which makes it a natural pick for students drawn to theatre and performance in the capital.
tiangong-university: Tiangong University, once called Tianjin Polytechnic University, is a public research university in Xiqing, Tianjin, founded in 1958. Its name means Tianjin Industrial University. It has around 30,000 students, is sponsored by the Tianjin municipal government, and is included in the Double First-Class Construction programme.
tianjin-foreign-studies-university: Tianjin Foreign Studies University (TFSU) is a public university focused on foreign languages in Tianjin, set up in 1964. The city of Tianjin oversees and funds it, so it is worth a look if you hope to study languages and cultures in northern China.
tianjin-medical-university: Tianjin Medical University (TMU) is a public medical school in Tianjin, established in 1951 and currently home to about 8,515 students. The city, the Ministry of Education and the National Health Commission all help fund it, and it has Project 211 status and a place in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
tianjin-normal-university: Tianjin Normal University (TNU) is a public research university in Tianjin that opened in 1958. It focuses on teacher education, and in 2017 to 2018 the Chinese University Alumni Association placed it 3rd among normal universities in north China.
tianjin-university: Tianjin University (TJU), formerly Peiyang University, is a research university in Tianjin run at national level. It was set up in 1895 by royal charter of the Guangxu Emperor and is regarded as China's oldest university. Around 15,000 students attend. The Ministry of Education funds it, and it holds Project 211 and Project 985 status and is in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
tianjin-university-of-finance-and-econom: TUFE, a finance and economics university in Tianjin, opened in 1958 as a public school. It was among the first in the country to teach applied economics and business administration, so it may appeal to anyone planning a career in commerce.
tianjin-university-of-science-and-techno: TUST is a public university in Binhai, Tianjin, backed by the municipal government. It began in 1958 as the Hebei Institute of Light Industry and gained full university status in 2002.
tianjin-university-of-technology: Tianjin University of Technology is a public technical university in Xiqing, Tianjin, established in 1996. The city of Tianjin oversees it and provides its funding, making it a local, practical option for engineering-minded students.
tianjin-university-of-technology-and-edu: TUTE is a public vocational university in the Hexi district of Tianjin, also known as Tianjin Vocational and Technical Normal University. Tianjin's city government sponsors it jointly with the national education ministry and the human resources and social security ministry.
tianjin-university-of-traditional-chines: This public medical university in Tianjin specialises in traditional Chinese medicine. Funding comes from the education ministry, the national traditional medicine administration and the city government, and it belongs to the Double First-Class Construction plan.
tibet-university: Tibet University, started in 1985 in Lhasa, is a regional public university affiliated with the Tibet Autonomous Region. About 10,685 students study there. Funding is shared by the regional government and the education ministry, and it has Project 211 status and a place in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
tongji-university: Tongji University is a national public university in Shanghai, with origins in 1907. Around 37,492 students are enrolled. Under the Ministry of Education, it is counted within Project 211 and Project 985 as well as the Double First-Class Construction, making it a well-regarded choice if you want to live in Shanghai.
tsinghua-university: Tsinghua University, founded in 1911, is a research university in Haidian, Beijing, home to roughly 62,496 students. The Ministry of Education funds it. It is a member of the C9 League and sits within the Double First-Class Construction, along with the earlier Project 211 and Project 985.
university-of-chinese-academy-of-science: UCAS has its headquarters in Shijingshan, Beijing, and operates as a public university. Created in 2012, it belongs to the country's science academy and sits in the Double First-Class Construction programme, so it suits students interested in science.
university-of-electronic-science-and-tec: UESTC, based in Chengdu, Sichuan, is a public university created in 1956 on the instruction of Premier Zhou Enlai, with around 40,000 students. Several bodies sponsor it, including the industry and information technology ministry, and it holds Project 211 and Project 985 status and is in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
university-of-international-business-and: UIBE is a public university in Chaoyang, Beijing, started in 1951. Both the education ministry and the commerce ministry fund it. It is China's only finance and economics university holding EQUIS, AACSB, CAMEA and AMBA accreditation, and has Project 211 status and a place in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
university-of-jinan: UJN, in Jinan, Shandong, is a public university run by the province and established in 2000. The Shandong government and the Ministry of Education co-fund it. It can award bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, and it takes part in Plan 111.
university-of-nottingham-ningbo-china: UNNC, in Ningbo, Zhejiang, is a joint Chinese and foreign university launched in 2004. Nottingham and Zhejiang Wanli University created it together, giving international students a joint-venture route into Chinese higher education.
university-of-science-and-technology-bei: USTB, founded in 1952, is a public university in the Haidian area of Beijing. Until 1988 it carried the name Beijing Steel and Iron Institute. The Ministry of Education oversees it, and it has Project 211 status and a place in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
university-of-science-and-technology-lia: The University of Science and Technology Liaoning is in Anshan, Liaoning Province, and is described as the earliest metallurgical university in China. It is a key university in Liaoning and takes part in the Ministry of Education's excellent engineer training programme.
university-of-science-and-technology-of-: USTC, in Hefei, Anhui, is a public university established in 1958 with around 16,718 students. The Chinese Academy of Sciences owns it, and it is co-funded by the Ministry of Education and the Anhui government. It holds Project 211 and Project 985 status and is in the Double First-Class Construction plan.
university-of-shanghai-for-science-and-t: USST is a public university in Yangpu, Shanghai, dating back to 1906. It has about 24,600 students and is funded by the Shanghai municipal government, giving international applicants a city-backed option in a major hub.
wenzhou-medical-university: Wenzhou Medical University (WMU), with origins in 1912, is a public university run by Zhejiang province in Wenzhou. It focuses on medical education, so it is worth considering if you hope to train in medicine in eastern China.
wenzhou-university: Wenzhou University sits in the coastal city of Wenzhou, in Zhejiang province. Founded in 1984, it is a public institution run by the city government, and it serves a student community of around 24,960. A friendly choice if you want a city-backed university in eastern China.
wuhan-sports-university: Wuhan Sports University, founded in 1953, is a public institution in Wuhan, Hubei, built around physical education, teaching and training. It is jointly set up by the national sport administration and the Hubei government, and in research circles it goes by the name Wuhan Institute of Physical Education. Sport-minded applicants will feel at home here.
wuhan-textile-university: Wuhan Textile University opened in 1958 and has grown into a public university with about 27,000 students. Its learning is spread over three campuses in Wuhan: Nanhu, Yangguang and Donghu. Together they cover more than 2,400 mu, so newcomers will find plenty of room to study, live and explore.
wuhan-university: Wuhan University welcomed its first students in 1926 and stands today in Wuhan, Hubei, as a state-run university with roughly 58,720 students. China's education ministry administers and funds it, and it carries the Project 985 and Project 211 labels along with Double First-Class status. Expect a big, well-resourced campus community.
wuhan-university-of-technology: Wuhan University of Technology traces its roots to 1898, making it one of the older names in Wuhan, Hubei. It is a state research university under the education ministry, and it takes part in Project 211 and the Double First-Class effort. Consider it if research-focused study appeals to you.
xiamen-university: Xiamen University, founded in 1921, calls the Siming district of Xiamen, Fujian, home, and about 28,133 students study there. This state university answers to the education ministry and holds Project 211, Project 985 and Double First-Class status, so it is a well-backed, nationally recognised choice by the sea.
xiamen-university-of-technology: Xiamen University of Technology serves students in Xiamen, Fujian, as a public institution run at provincial level. Its Chinese name literally reads as Xiamen Polytechnic College, which hints at a practical, technical focus. Worth a look if you want a technology-minded school in a coastal Fujian city.
xian-jiaotong-university: Xi'an Jiaotong University dates from 1896 and sits in Xi'an, Shaanxi, with around 32,000 students. This state university is funded through the education ministry, holds Project 211, Project 985 and Double First-Class status, and joins the C9 League, the group of China's leading research universities.
xian-shiyou-university: Xi'an Shiyou University, also called Xi'an Petroleum University, started in 1951 and now teaches about 22,000 students. In Northwest China it is the sole multi-disciplinary college with a petroleum and petrochemical identity, ranks among five well-known petroleum universities nationwide, and trains students from undergraduate to doctoral level.
xiangtan-university: Xiangtan University opened in 1958 in Xiangtan, Hunan, and runs at provincial level while serving as a state institution. Hunan province affiliates with it, and funding is shared by the provincial government, the education ministry and SASTIND. It also takes part in the Double First-Class effort, a sound option for students seeking a well-backed provincial school.
xidian-university: Xidian University began in 1931 and teaches about 22,487 students in Xi'an, Shaanxi, as a state university. Its Chinese name points to electronic science and technology. The education ministry is its parent body, supported by industry and electronics bodies, and it is part of Project 211 and the Double First-Class effort.
xinjiang-medical-university: Xinjiang Medical University, formerly known as Xinjiang Medical College, is a public medical school in Urumqi, capital of the Uyghur Autonomous Region in Xinjiang. It started in 1956, serves about 21,682 students, and gained national ministry ratification as a university in 1998. A fitting home for aspiring doctors and health workers.
xinjiang-normal-university: Xinjiang Normal University is a state university in the Uyghur region of Xinjiang, established in December 1978 with ministry approval. It grew out of Urumqi First Normal School and a teacher training department, so teaching and education sit at the heart of its story. Good to know if you hope to become a teacher.
xinjiang-university: Xinjiang University, founded in 1924, is a comprehensive state university at provincial level in Urumqi, Xinjiang. It is recognised nationally as a key university, attached to the regional authorities and jointly funded by them and the education ministry. It also joins Project 211 and the Double First-Class effort.
xuzhou-medical-university: Xuzhou Medical University, founded in 1958, is a medical school run at provincial level in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Province. It is a public institution and counts well over thirteen thousand students. If you hope to build a career in medicine or healthcare, this focused school in northern Jiangsu is worth adding to your shortlist.
yanbian-university: Yanbian University has been open since 1949 in Yanji, in the Yanbian area of Jilin. It is affiliated with Jilin province, funded jointly by provincial authorities and the education ministry, and it joins Project 211 and the Double First-Class effort. A well-supported public option in northeast China.
yangtze-university: Yangtze University, established in 2003, is a state-run university at provincial level in Jingzhou, Hubei. It belongs to Hubei province and receives its main sponsorship from the provincial government. As one of the younger names on this list, it offers a regional base for study in central China.
yangzhou-university: Yangzhou University in Yangzhou, Jiangsu Province, took shape in 1992, when six local colleges merged into one institution. It is a state university, and it provides both undergraduate and graduate programmes, giving international applicants a broad choice within a single campus community.
yanshan-university: Yanshan University has roots going back to 1920 and operates at provincial level in Qinhuangdao, Hebei, under the Hebei government. With around 40,000 students, it is a sizeable community, and its coastal city location may appeal if you like studying away from the biggest metropolises.
yantai-university: Yantai University, in Yantai, Shandong, is a key state university set up in 1984 with help from Peking University and Tsinghua University. It was among the first group of schools chosen for the Shandong Province Famous University Project, a sign of strong provincial backing for international applicants.
yunnan-minzu-university: Yunnan Minzu University serves students in Kunming, Yunnan, as a public institution run at provincial level under the Yunnan Provincial People's Government. The word Minzu in its name points to a focus on ethnic studies and communities. Ask the admissions team for programme details before you apply.
yunnan-normal-university: Yunnan Normal University, founded in 1938, is a normal university at provincial level in Kunming, Yunnan, meaning teacher education is central to its mission. Yunnan Province and the education ministry sponsor it together, so it is a sound option for future teachers.
yunnan-university: Yunnan University opened in 1922 in Kunming, Yunnan, and about 31,141 students attend this state institution. Provincial authorities and the education ministry fund it together, and it holds Project 211 and Double First-Class status, making it a leading name in southwest China.
yunnan-university-of-finance-and-economi: Yunnan University of Finance and Economics, founded in 1951, is a key provincial university in Kunming, Yunnan, with some 34,000 students. Its strengths lie in commerce and management, so it is a natural fit if you hope to study business, finance or related subjects in southwest China.
zhejiang-gongshang-university: Zhejiang Gongshang University, founded in 1911, is a state-run university at provincial level in Hangzhou, Zhejiang. Its Chinese name translates as Zhejiang Industrial and Commercial University, which reflects a business flavour. It belongs to the province, and Hangzhou makes a lively setting for international students.
zhejiang-ocean-university: Zhejiang Ocean University was founded in 1988 and is based in Zhoushan, a city in Zhejiang province. It has about 14,400 students and is state-run. The name hints at a marine focus, so check its programmes if the sea and coastal studies interest you.
zhejiang-sci-tech-university: Zhejiang Sci-Tech University is a state institution in Zhejiang province with a history dating to 1897. Around 27,000 students study there. Its Chinese name stresses science and technology, so it may suit you if you want a long-established school with a technical direction.
zhejiang-university: Zhejiang University was founded in 1928 and stands in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, as a state university under the education ministry. Its status covers Project 985 and Project 211 as well as the Double First-Class scheme. Prospective international students will find a nationally prominent institution in a famously pleasant city.
zhejiang-university-of-science-and-techn: Zhejiang University of Science and Technology, known as ZUST, started in 1980 and is a provincial undergraduate university with about 19000 students. It is application-oriented, can award bachelor's and master's degrees, and welcomes international students. Its main campus is in Xihu District, Hangzhou, with a branch campus in Anji.
zhejiang-university-of-technology: Zhejiang University of Technology, founded in 1953, is a comprehensive state university in Hangzhou, capital of Zhejiang, and belongs to the province. If you like the idea of studying in a major provincial capital at a technology-minded school, put it on your list.
zhengzhou-university: Zhengzhou University has been open since 1928 in Zhengzhou, Henan, and with around 72,600 students it is a very large community. It operates at provincial level under Henan province, and it holds Project 211 and Double First-Class status.
zhongnan-university-of-economics-and-law: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, founded in 1948, is a public university in Wuhan, Hubei. The Ministry of Education oversees it, with joint funding from the Ministry of Finance and the Hubei government. It belongs to Project 211 and the Double First-Class Construction, and focuses on finance, economics and law.
